content.value: A [[article/campfire|Campfire]] provides early cooking without committing to a full fuel-driven kitchen. It can cook the assigned raw meats, cod, salmon, potatoes and other supported [[article/campfire|campfire]] foods.

Use its cooking interaction and available station interface to place suitable food. [[article/campfire|Campfire]] cooking is the slower early option; the [[article/smoker|Smoker]] processes food faster and supports more advanced assigned foods.
The [[article/campfire|campfire]] remains a world block with its normal environmental fire behavior. Standing in its flames is not safe.
